layout.arrangement: Red 3-line title at top-left; small pale-yellow formula box on the middle-left below the title; a large circular angle diagram dominating the center and right of the slide; yellow slide-number oval '28' in the top-right corner; a thin red rectangular border frames the entire slide content; a solid black bar runs along the very bottom edge (video-frame artifact).

regions.name: Title block
regions.content: Three lines of bold red text: 'Sequence of 9 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles' (third line indented right).

regions.content: Pale-yellow circle with dashed red axes and spokes, nine mint-green 'Word 0'-'Word 8' boxes around it, and eight curved '+ω' arrows connecting consecutive words counterclockwise.

regions.content: Yellow ellipse outlined in dark color containing the black number '28'.

layout.hierarchy: The circular diagram dominates visually (largest area, central position). The red bold title is second in weight. The mint-green word boxes and red '+ω' labels are the next layer of detail. The formula box, slide-number oval, red frame, and black bar are small peripheral accents.

visual_elements.description: Central pale-yellow filled circle (center at ~60% slide width, ~52% slide height; diameter ~26% of slide width) representing an angle/phase space. A thin red DASHED horizontal axis passes through the circle center spanning roughly x 26%-93% of the slide; a red DASHED vertical axis passes through the center from ~y 8% to ~y 94%. Red dashed radial spokes run from the center to just beyond the rim at ~30-degree intervals. Nine small mint-green rectangles (~65x22 px) with thin borders sit OUTSIDE the rim on the spokes, counterclockwise from the 3-o'clock position: 'Word 0' at 0 degrees (right, horizontal), 'Word 1' at ~30 degrees, 'Word 2' at ~60 degrees, 'Word 3' at 90 degrees (top, box vertical with text rotated reading bottom-to-top), 'Word 4' at ~120 degrees, 'Word 5' at ~150 degrees, 'Word 6' at 180 degrees (left, horizontal), 'Word 7' at ~210 degrees, 'Word 8' at ~240 degrees (lower-left); each box is rotated parallel to its spoke. Eight thin curved orange-red arrows arc counterclockwise outside the word boxes, connecting each word to the next (Word 0 to Word 1, Word 1 to Word 2, ... Word 7 to Word 8), each terminating in a small solid triangular arrowhead at the destination word; a red bold-italic '+ω' label sits beside the midpoint of each of the 8 arcs. One extra dashed spoke continues to ~330 degrees (lower-right) with no word box attached.
visual_elements.position: center-right of slide, occupying roughly x 28-96%, y 8-95%

visual_elements.description: Small pale-yellow rectangle with a thin gold/olive border containing three stacked lines of bold text: line 1 'Sin(ω t)' in blue, line 2 'Cos(ω t)' in blue, line 3 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green.
visual_elements.position: middle-left, below the title, approx x 8-23%, y 34-47%

visual_elements.description: Slide-number badge: small yellow ellipse with a dark navy/black outline containing the black bold number '28'.

Thin red rectangular border framing the slide content area (inset ~6% from left/right, ~8% from top, meeting the black bar at bottom), plus a solid black full-width strip along the very bottom edge of the frame (video player artifact, no text on it).

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Only a small white mouse-pointer cursor with black outline visible near the 'Word 1' box (~x 76%, y 38%), an artifact of the screen recording, not slide content.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title: bold, ~24-26 px, red, three lines, left-aligned with the third line ('as angles') indented right. Word-box labels: bold italic, ~13 px, green. '+ω' labels: bold italic, ~16 px, red. Formula-box text: bold, ~15 px, blue for Sin/Cos lines and green for the t= line. Slide number: bold, ~16 px, black. No serif fonts, no all-caps, no numbered bullets anywhere.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: all 9 word boxes and all 8 '+ω' arrows are visible simultaneously. A mouse cursor rests near 'Word 1', indicating live narration/pointing during recording; no mid-build reveal detected.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). Add a thin red (#CC0000) rectangle outline framing the content, inset ~6% from left/right and ~8% from top, stopping at the bottom edge. 2. Add the title top-left as three separate lines in Arial Bold ~24 pt, red #CC0000: 'Sequence of 9 words', 'Positions are defined', 'as angles' (indent the third line ~0.5 inch). 3. Draw a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) circle with a very thin gray-green outline, centered at ~60% slide width and ~52% slide height, diameter ~26% of slide width. 4. Draw red (#CC0000) DASHED lines: one horizontal through the circle center spanning ~26%-93% of slide width, one vertical through the center from ~8% to ~94% of slide height. 5. Add red dashed radial spokes from the center to just past the rim at 30-degree intervals (0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240 degrees, plus one extra spoke at ~330 degrees lower-right with no box). 6. Create nine mint-green (#CCFFCC) rectangles (~0.9 x 0.3 inch) with thin borders and green (#009900) bold italic ~12 pt text: 'Word 0' through 'Word 8'. Place them counterclockwise starting at the 3-o'clock position, one per spoke, just outside the circle rim; rotate each box parallel to its spoke (Word 0 and Word 6 horizontal, Word 3 vertical at top with text reading bottom-to-top, Word 8 at lower-left ~240 degrees). 7. Draw eight thin curved arrows (curved connectors or block arcs) outside the word boxes, each arcing counterclockwise from Word k to Word k+1 (Word 0 to Word 1 through Word 7 to Word 8); use orange-red stroke (~#E06040) with solid orange (#FF6600) triangular arrowheads at the destination end. 8. Beside the midpoint of each arc, place a red (#CC0000) bold italic '+ω' text label (8 instances total). 9. Add a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) rectangle with a thin gold (#E0C040) border at middle-left (below the title); inside, three bold ~14 pt lines: 'Sin(ω t)' in blue #0000CC, 'Cos(ω t)' in blue #0000CC, 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green #009900. 10. Add a small yellow (#FFFF00) ellipse with a dark navy outline in the top-right corner containing black bold '28'. 11. Optionally add a solid black rectangle strip across the very bottom edge (~5% of slide height) to mimic the video-frame bar.
